premises.text: Meshed carbon-nanotube filters' conductivity and high surface area shrink electrochemical metal deposition from industrial plant scale to coffee-cup scale and precipitate metals from liquid solution
premises.evidence_span: Those two properties, electrical conductivity and high surface areas per unit mass, give us the ability to shrink a process that used to require the size of a cubic football field down to the size of a coffee cup

premises.text: The process separates bulk metals from rare earth elements so manufacturers can reclaim metals from the manufacturing floor and from old products
premises.evidence_span: Our process is able to separate bulk elements from rare earth elements, and we think that that's going to give the electronics manufacturers the ability to put new life into new process from reclaimed metals, both from their manufacturing floor as well as from old products

premises.text: Critical metals for electronics and energy storage face globally distributed demand but concentrated, geopolitically risky supply
premises.evidence_span: while there's a globally distributed need for these materials, the supply of them is focused in a small number of countries

premises.text: No existing technology turns disassembled device component boxes back into primary elements for new manufacturing
premises.evidence_span: there is no technology that can take those boxes of components sitting on the disassembly floor and turn them back into the primary elements that you need for novel manufacturing

premises.text: Short-term use recovers hard-fought metals lost in manufacturing effluent to improve fabrication efficiencies
premises.evidence_span: About half of the material, that hard fought expensive material, goes out the effluent stream of these manufacturing plants. And we want to see that changed

premises.text: CNT filters assembled in series individually recover mixed metals at high purity and recovery, including copper, europium, cobalt, and nickel
premises.evidence_span: we take these carbon nanotube filters, assemble them in series, and we can introduce a mixed metal waste solution at the top of the filter stack and individually recover those metals

domains.name: Manufacturing effluent and end-of-life reclaim use cases

value.text: Return control of the metal supply chain to manufacturers via reclaimed metals
value.evidence_span: returns control of the metal supply chain to the manufacturer

secondary_value.text: American innovation not limited by metal supply
secondary_value.evidence_span: a future where American innovation isn't limited by supply of metals, but by the imaginations of the innovators

causal_links.evidence_span: delivering a charge across the mesh of carbon nanotube filters to try and precipitate metals contained in a liquid solution as solid materials
the supply of them is focused in a small number of countries
help them digest those individual components and reclaim the individual metals
